task.title: Prevent SIGTERM transcript source false positives

scope.owned_layer: Authoritative provider-evidence gating for worker transcript scanning, excluding supervisor SIGTERM preemption (terminated / exit code 143) from plain-text regex scanning.
scope.not_changing: Provider credentials, account/quota grouping, retry thresholds, reviewer policy, runtime-state JSON, live process signals, and product code.

contract.plain_text_gate: A worker_runner terminal failure status (RUNNER_FAILURE_STATUSES = 'error', 'failed') is required before plain transcript lines can enter regex classification. Status 'terminated' (SIGTERM / exit code 143) is excluded to prevent preemption false positives.
contract.provider_envelope_gate: Structured provider streams independently admit only explicit terminal result/error/failure envelopes and rejected rate-limit control events.
mixed_trust_exclusions: assistant prose without a terminal control envelope
contract.missing_process_fallback: Quota-like log text without a runner/provider terminal envelope remains failure_kind missing_process and never opens a quota dispatch pause.

verification.result: checkout-scoped .venv-pantheon provisioned and dependency imports verified

verification.command: .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -q .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py -k 'DetectWorkerFailureTests or RuntimeLeaseReconciliationTests or AllowedRateLimitNoticeTests or pause_dispatch_for_reaped_worker'

rollout_and_rollback.rollout_boundary: Per-task PR auto-merge into dev; supervisor picks up the updated RUNNER_FAILURE_STATUSES gate on next cycle.
rollout_and_rollback.rollback_strategy: Merge revert PR on dev or master if supervisor worker-failure classification regresses.
